hooks.logic:
Let container be the group of the enemy.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let withoutAbilityList be the excluded moves of the enemy with options {forceIgnoresReflection: false}.
  If part 1 of container is dead, then
    Let ability be the id of the move labelled "sos" on the enemy.
    Set withoutAbilityList to _ → union with (withoutAbilityList, [ability]).
  Let ability2 be a weighted random move of the enemy other than withoutAbilityList.
  The enemy uses ability2.
